{

  "task": {
    "id": "swap_deposit",
    "title": "兑换后存入",

    "allowedTools": [
      "get_balance",
      "get_state",
      "approve_token",
      "swap",
      "deposit"
    ],
    "completion": "本次正确兑换、新增B全部进入vault、agent份额按本次存入增加；原有B余额、份额和其他账户资产保留。",
    "taskParameters": {
      "amountIn": "10",
      "minAmountOut": "9"
    },
    "parameterSource": "structured",
    "tokenDecimals": 6

  "automine": true,
  "manual": false,

  "experimentMode": "independent",
  "maxSteps": 30,
  "maxMessages": 0,

      },

      "maxGasWei": "100000000000000000",
      "tools": [
        "get_balance",
        "transfer_token",
        "approve_token",
        "swap",
        "deposit"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
